senses.def: be obliged to pay or repay
be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense
ex: This new theory owes much to Einstein's Relativity Theory
I still owe for the car
The thesis owes much to his adviser

senses.def: nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes
belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive

ex: He owns three houses in Florida

senses.def: having an owner; often used in combination
(law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business
ex: he is the owner of a chain of restaurants
they are searching for the owner of the car
who is the owner of that friendly smile?

senses.def: the relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others
the act of having and controlling property
the state or fact of being an owner
